tables.name: v_team_stats_career
tables.description: view of the statistics of the teams in the tournaments history, including their name, confederation, matches played, wins, draws, losses, goals scored, goals conceded, amount of times they reached the round of 16, amount of times they reached the quarter-finals, amount of times they reached the semi-finals, amount of times they reached the final, amount of tournaments won, amount of times they were runners-up, amount of times they were third place, amount of times they were fourth place, and tournament apearances. Made to reduce the need for joins when querying for team statistics.
tables.note: Historical note: West Germany ('West Germany', active 1954-1990) and reunified Germany ('Germany', active 1930-1950 and 1994-present) are stored as separate team_id/team_name entries. When a user asks about 'Germany' without specifying which era, consider whether the question implies combining both entities (e.g. 'career top scorers' style questions) using team_name LIKE '%Germany%' or explicit team_name IN ('Germany', 'West Germany'), versus questions about a specific tournament year where only one entity applies naturally.
